summary: Groq Cloud offers a free tier (no credit card required) with access to gpt-oss-120b and Qwen 3.8 27B models via API, rate-limited. Ongoing developer program, not a time-limited promo.
claim_steps: Sign up for Groq Cloud at console.groq.com.
Create an API key under the free tier.
Call gpt-oss-120b or Qwen 3.8 27B via the Groq API — rate-limited, no card required.
